run_SSL_training: run the emcom_as_ssl training pipeline with argparse CLI params for distributed SSL training
build_game: build the communication game model from parsed options using build_game(opts)
create_dataloader: create a data loader for SSL training with get_dataloader using dataset_dir and batch_size

get_callbacks: get training callbacks for temperature scheduling and checkpointing using get_callbacks
